title.raw: 卷56 志三十一 地理三 吉林

sentences.zh: 志三十一

translations.literal: Treatises thirty-one
translations.idiomatic: Treatises 31

sentences.zh: 地理三

translations.literal: Geography three
translations.idiomatic: Geography 3

sentences.zh: 吉林

translations.literal: Jilin
translations.idiomatic: Jilin

sentences.zh: 吉林：古肅慎國之域。

translations.literal: Jilin: the territory of the ancient Sushen kingdom.
translations.idiomatic: Jilin: the territory of the ancient Sushen kingdom.

sentences.zh: 明初，奴兒干都司地，領衛百八十四、所二十。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Ming, it was territory of the Nue'ergan Military Commission, administering one hundred eighty-four guards and twenty battalions.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Ming dynasty, it fell under the jurisdiction of the Nue'ergan Military Commission, which administered 184 guard units and 20 battalion units.

sentences.zh: 後為長白山三部、扈倫四部所屬輝發、烏拉、葉赫，兼有哈達北境及東海部地。

translations.literal: Later it belonged to Huifa, Wula, and Yehe, which were subject to the three Changbai Mountain tribes and the four Hulun tribes, and also included the northern borderlands of Hada and the territory of the Donghai tribes.
translations.idiomatic: Later it came under Huifa, Wula, and Yehe — tribes subject to the three Changbai Mountain confederations and the four Hulun tribes — and also encompassed the northern reaches of Hada and the lands of the Donghai tribes.

sentences.zh: 清初，建滿洲城於俄漠惠之野鄂多理城。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Qing, the Manchu city was built at Oduoli city in the wilderness of Emohui.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Qing, the Manchu city was established at Oduoli, in the wilderness of Emohui.

sentences.zh: 順治十年，置昂邦章京及副都統二人鎮守寧古塔。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Shunzhi, an angbang jiangjing and two deputy commanders were appointed to garrison Ningguta.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of the Shunzhi reign, an angbang jiangjing and two deputy commanders were appointed to garrison Ningguta.

sentences.zh: 康熙元年，改寧古塔將軍。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kangxi, the post was changed to General of Ningguta.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Kangxi reign, the post was redesignated as General of Ningguta.

sentences.zh: 十五年徙，改吉林將軍。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was transferred, and the title was changed to General of Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year the general was transferred and the title changed to General of Jilin.

sentences.zh: 先是十年徙副都統一人駐吉林，三十三年徙伯都訥。

translations.literal: Previously, in the tenth year one deputy commander was transferred to garrison Jilin; in the thirty-third year he was transferred to Boduna.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, in the tenth year one deputy commander had been transferred to garrison Jilin; in the thirty-third year that post was moved to Boduna.

sentences.zh: 雍正三年，復置吉林阿勒楚喀副都統。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yongzheng, the Jilin Aletchuka deputy commander was reestablished.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of the Yongzheng reign, the Jilin Aletchuka deputy commander was reestablished.

sentences.zh: 五年，增三姓副都統。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, a Sanxing deputy commander was added.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, a deputy commander for Sanxing was added.

sentences.zh: 光緒七年，置琿春副都統，吉林、賓州、五常三廳。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Guangxu, a Hunchun deputy commander was established, along with the three subprefectures of Jilin, Binzhou, and Wuchang.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of the Guangxu reign, a Hunchun deputy commander was established, along with the subprefectures of Jilin, Binzhou, and Wuchang.

sentences.zh: 八年，吉林廳陞府。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Jilin Subprefecture was promoted to a prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, Jilin Subprefecture was promoted to a prefecture.

sentences.zh: 後增長春、新城、依蘭，各領縣有差。

translations.literal: Later Changchun, Xincheng, and Yilan were added, each administering counties to varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Later Changchun, Xincheng, and Yilan were added, each with its own complement of counties under its jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 三十三年建行省，改將軍為巡撫，盡裁副都統等。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year a provincial administration was established, the general was changed to a governor, and all deputy commanders and the like were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year the region was organized as a province: the general's post was replaced by a governor, and all deputy commander positions were abolished.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年，定西南、西北、東南、東北四路為四道。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xuantong, the four routes — Southwest, Northwest, Southeast, and Northeast — were designated as four circuit intendancies.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of the Xuantong reign, the Southwest, Northwest, Southeast, and Northeast routes were established as four circuit intendancies.

sentences.zh: 凡轄府十有一，州一，廳五，縣十八。

translations.literal: In all it administered eleven prefectures, one department, five subprefectures, and eighteen counties.
translations.idiomatic: In all it administered eleven prefectures, one department, five subprefectures, and eighteen counties.

sentences.zh: 西至伊通州，界盛京；

translations.literal: To the west, as far as Yitong Prefecture, bordering Shengjing;
translations.idiomatic: To the west it extended to Yitong Prefecture, bordering Shengjing;

sentences.zh: 東至烏蘇里江，界俄領東海濱省；

translations.literal: To the east, as far as the Ussuri River, bordering Russian Maritime Province;
translations.idiomatic: To the east it reached the Ussuri River, bordering Russian Maritime Province;

sentences.zh: 北至松花江，界黑龍江；

translations.literal: To the north, as far as the Songhua River, bordering Heilongjiang;
translations.idiomatic: To the north it extended to the Songhua River, bordering Heilongjiang;

sentences.zh: 南至圖們、鴨綠江，界朝鮮。

translations.literal: To the south, as far as the Tumen and Yalu rivers, bordering Korea.
translations.idiomatic: To the south it reached the Tumen and Yalu rivers, bordering Korea.

sentences.zh: 廣二千四百餘里，袤千五百餘里。

translations.literal: It measured over two thousand four hundred li in breadth and over one thousand five hundred li in length.
translations.idiomatic: It measured over 2,400 li from east to west and over 1,500 li from north to south.

sentences.zh: 北極高四十一度三十分至四十五度四十分。

translations.literal: Its latitude ranged from forty-one degrees thirty minutes to forty-five degrees forty minutes north.
translations.idiomatic: Its latitude ranged from 41°30′ to 45°40′ north.

sentences.zh: 京師偏東九度八分至十三度十分。

translations.literal: It lay between nine degrees eight minutes and thirteen degrees ten minutes east of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: It lay between 9°08′ and 13°10′ east of the capital.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年，編戶七十三萬九千四百六十一，口三百七十三萬五千一百六十七。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xuantong, registered households numbered seven hundred thirty-nine thousand four hundred sixty-one, and population three million seven hundred thirty-five thousand one hundred sixty-seven.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of the Xuantong reign, registered households numbered 739,461 and the population stood at 3,735,167.

sentences.zh: 案：吉之舊界，東至寧古塔八百餘里，又烏扎庫邊卡七百餘里，又松阿察河三百里，又千餘里至海，凡三千里有奇。

translations.literal: Note: Jilin's old border extended east to Ningguta, over eight hundred li; then another over seven hundred li to the Wuzhaku border post; then three hundred li along the Songacha River; then over one thousand li to the sea — in all over three thousand li.
translations.idiomatic: Note: On Jilin's old borders, the eastern frontier ran eight hundred-odd li to Ningguta, then seven hundred-odd li further to the Wuzhaku border post, then three hundred li along the Songacha River, and then over a thousand li to the sea — more than three thousand li in all.

sentences.zh: 其東北至三姓千二百里，又五百餘里富克錦，又七百餘里烏蘇里江口，又二千餘里至廟爾，實四千四百里有奇。

translations.literal: From the northeast to Sanxing was one thousand two hundred li; then over five hundred li to Fukujin; then over seven hundred li to the mouth of the Ussuri River; then over two thousand li to Miao'er — in all over four thousand four hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: From the northeast, it was twelve hundred li to Sanxing, then five hundred-odd li to Fukujin, then seven hundred-odd li to the mouth of the Ussuri River, and then over two thousand li to Miao'er — more than four thousand four hundred li in all.

sentences.zh: 又自富克錦逾混同，循黑龍江東界，北至外興安嶺，二千里有奇。

translations.literal: From Fukujin, crossing the Huntong and following the eastern border of the Heilong River north to the Outer Khingan Range, was over two thousand li.
translations.idiomatic: From Fukujin, crossing the Huntong and following the eastern bank of the Heilong River north to the Outer Khingan Range, was over two thousand li.

sentences.zh: 又自琿春而東至海參崴，又東七百里有奇錫林河。

translations.literal: From Hunchun eastward to Haishenwai, and then east another over seven hundred li to the Xilin River.
translations.idiomatic: From Hunchun eastward to Haishenwai, and then another seven hundred-odd li east to the Xilin River.

sentences.zh: 其中部落，若費雅，居圖庫魯、鄂古二河之間，在混同江北海濱；

translations.literal: Among the tribes within this region, the Feiya lived between the Tukuru and Egu rivers, on the northern coast of the Huntong River;
translations.idiomatic: Among the tribes in this region, the Feiya lived between the Tukuru and Egu rivers, on the northern coast of the Huntong River;

sentences.zh: 若費雅喀，居額濟第河西；

translations.literal: the Feiyaka lived west of the Ejidai River;
translations.idiomatic: the Feiyaka lived west of the Ejidai River;

sentences.zh: 若貢豹，居約色河北；

translations.literal: the Gongbao lived north of the Yuese River;
translations.idiomatic: the Gongbao lived north of the Yuese River;

sentences.zh: 若奇雅喀喇，居約色河南，並混同江東南海濱。

translations.literal: the Qiyakala lived south of the Yuese River — all on the southeastern coast of the Huntong River.
translations.idiomatic: and the Qiyakala lived south of the Yuese River — all on the southeastern coast of the Huntong River.

sentences.zh: 其自混同江口西至黑勒爾，則濟勒彌部居之，即金史之濟勒敏；

translations.literal: From the mouth of the Huntong River west to Hele'er, the Jilemi tribe lived there — that is, the Jilemin of the History of Jin;
translations.idiomatic: From the mouth of the Huntong River west to Hele'er lived the Jilemi tribe — the Jilemin recorded in the History of Jin;

sentences.zh: 自黑勒爾西至阿吉大山，沿混同江兩岸，則額登喀喇部居之，即不薙髮黑斤；

translations.literal: from Hele'er west to Aji Mountain, along both banks of the Huntong River, the Edengkala tribe lived there — that is, the unshorn Heijin;
translations.idiomatic: from Hele'er west to Aji Mountain, along both banks of the Huntong River, lived the Edengkala tribe — the unshorn Heijin;

sentences.zh: 自阿吉大山西至伯利，則赫哲喀喇居之，即薙髮黑斤；

translations.literal: from Aji Mountain west to Boli, the Hezhekala lived there — that is, the shorn Heijin;
translations.idiomatic: from Aji Mountain west to Boli lived the Hezhekala — the shorn Heijin;

sentences.zh: 並久隸版圖，比於編戶。

translations.literal: all had long been subject to the empire, on a par with registered households.
translations.idiomatic: all had long been subject to the empire, counted no differently from registered households.

sentences.zh: 咸豐八年愛琿之約，以烏蘇里江口為新界，失地二千餘里，然于吉只東北一隅。

translations.literal: Under the Aihun Convention of the eighth year of Xianfeng, the mouth of the Ussuri River became the new border, and over two thousand li of territory were lost — yet this affected only a corner of Jilin's northeast.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Aihun Convention of the eighth year of the Xianfeng reign, the mouth of the Ussuri River became the new border, costing over two thousand li of territory — yet this affected only a corner of Jilin's northeast.

sentences.zh: 十一年北京之約，自烏蘇里江口溯流至松阿察河，逾興凱湖西至白棱河口，又逾大綏芬河而南至瑚布圖河口，又南而西至圖們江口以東舊界屬俄，以烏札庫邊卡瑚布圖河口為新界，又失數千里，遂無復有江口入海為吉轄境者。

translations.literal: Under the Beijing Convention of the eleventh year, from the mouth of the Ussuri River upstream to the Songacha River, west across Lake Xingkai to the mouth of the Bailing River, then across the Da Suifen River south to the mouth of the Hubutu River, then south and west to the old border east of the mouth of the Tumen River — all went to Russia; with the Wuzhaku border post at the mouth of the Hubutu River as the new border, several thousand li more were lost, and Jilin no longer had any river mouth opening to the sea within its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Beijing Convention of the eleventh year, from the mouth of the Ussuri River upstream to the Songacha River, west across Lake Xingkai to the mouth of the Bailing River, then across the Da Suifen River south to the mouth of the Hubutu River, and then south and west to the old border east of the Tumen estuary — all of this passed to Russia. With the Wuzhaku border post at the mouth of the Hubutu River as the new boundary, several thousand li more were lost, and Jilin no longer had any river mouth opening to the sea within its jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 光緒十二年，黑頂子勘界，定琿春之海口屬俄，則圖們江口內去海三十里「土」字界碑為中俄新界矣。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Guangxu, during the Heidingzi boundary survey, it was determined that Hunchun's river mouth belonged to Russia; the new Sino-Russian border became the "Tu" character boundary marker thirty li inland from the sea at the mouth of the Tumen River.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of the Guangxu reign, during the Heidingzi boundary survey, Hunchun's river mouth was assigned to Russia, and the new Sino-Russian border was fixed at the "Tu" character boundary marker thirty li inland from the sea at the mouth of the Tumen River.

sentences.zh: 又東北海中庫葉島，一曰黑龍嶼，廣三四百里，袤二千餘里。

translations.literal: Further, in the northeast sea lies Kuye Island, also called Heilong Islet — over three or four hundred li in breadth and over two thousand li in length.
translations.idiomatic: In the northeast sea lies Kuye Island, also called Heilong Islet — over three or four hundred li wide and over two thousand li long.

sentences.zh: 西北圖克蘇圖山，山陰社瓦狼、陽費雅喀部，南有阿當吉山，山東嵩闊洛、南俄倫春部，又南雅丹部，並天命中內附。

translations.literal: To the northwest is Tukusutu Mountain; on its northern slope live the Shewalang and Feiyaka tribes, and to the south is Adangji Mountain; on its eastern slope live the Songkuoluo and southern Oroqen tribes, and further south the Yadan tribe — all submitted to the dynasty during the Tianming reign.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest stands Tukusutu Mountain; on its northern slope live the Shewalang and Feiyaka tribes. To the south is Adangji Mountain; on its eastern slope live the Songkuoluo and southern Oroqen tribes, and further south the Yadan tribe — all of whom submitted to the dynasty during the Tianming reign.

sentences.zh: 遼遠不克時至，歲以夏六月遣使至寧古塔東北三千里普魯鄉貢獻，頒賚有差。

translations.literal: The distance was too great for them to come regularly; each year in the sixth month of summer envoys were sent to Puluxiang, three thousand li northeast of Ningguta, to receive their tribute offerings, and rewards were distributed according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: The distance was too great for them to come regularly; each year in the sixth month envoys were dispatched to Puluxiang, three thousand li northeast of Ningguta, to receive their tribute offerings, and rewards were distributed according to rank.

sentences.zh: 後屬三姓。

translations.literal: Later they came under Sanxing.
translations.idiomatic: Later they came under the jurisdiction of Sanxing.

sentences.zh: 今亦為俄有矣。

translations.literal: Now this too belongs to Russia.
translations.idiomatic: Now this too belongs to Russia.

sentences.zh: 又東南海中蝦夷島，康熙中屢偕庫葉人至混同江境內貢貂受賞，後亦隸日。

translations.literal: Further, in the southeast sea lies the Ainu Island; during the Kangxi reign its people repeatedly came with the Kuye people to the Huntong River region to offer sable tribute and receive rewards, but later they too came under Japanese rule.
translations.idiomatic: In the southeast sea lies the Ainu Island; during the Kangxi reign its people repeatedly came with the Kuye people into the Huntong River region to offer sable tribute and receive rewards, but later they too came under Japanese rule.

sentences.zh: 其名山：長白。

translations.literal: Its famous mountains: Changbai.
translations.idiomatic: Its notable mountains include Changbai.

sentences.zh: 北迤者，黑山、平頂。

translations.literal: Extending northward are Hei Mountain and Pingding.
translations.idiomatic: Extending northward are Hei Mountain and Pingding.

sentences.zh: 歧為二：西支，西北迤為色齊窩集、張廣才嶺，至拉林；

translations.literal: These divide into two branches: the western branch extends northwest as Seqiwoji and Zhangguangcai Range, reaching Lalin;
translations.idiomatic: These divide into two branches: the western branch runs northwest as Seqiwoji and the Zhangguangcai Range, reaching Lalin;

sentences.zh: 東支，東北迤為哈爾巴嶺、老松嶺。

translations.literal: the eastern branch extends northeast as Ha'erba Range and Laosong Range.
translations.idiomatic: the eastern branch runs northeast as the Ha'erba Range and the Laosong Range.

sentences.zh: 至綏芬河源復歧，一東訖俄東海濱省，一東北為察庫蘭嶺、哈達嶺、阿爾哈山。

translations.literal: At the source of the Suifen River they divide again: one branch extends east to Russian Maritime Province; the other runs northeast as Chakulan Range, Hada Range, and A'erha Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: At the source of the Suifen River they divide again: one branch extends east into Russian Maritime Province; the other runs northeast as the Chakulan Range, Hada Range, and A'erha Mountain.

sentences.zh: 其巨川：松花、混同、嫩江、牡丹、烏蘇里、圖們諸江。

translations.literal: Its great rivers: the Songhua, Huntong, Nen, Mudan, Ussuri, and Tumen rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Its major rivers are the Songhua, Huntong, Nen, Mudan, Ussuri, and Tumen.

sentences.zh: 其驛路：西達盛京開原；

translations.literal: Its courier routes: west to Kaiyuan in Shengjing;
translations.idiomatic: Its courier routes ran west to Kaiyuan in Shengjing;

sentences.zh: 北齊齊哈爾；

translations.literal: north to Qiqihar;
translations.idiomatic: north to Qiqihar;

sentences.zh: 西南達琿春。

translations.literal: southwest to Hunchun.
translations.idiomatic: and southwest to Hunchun.

sentences.zh: 電線：東達海參崴，北齊齊哈爾，西南達奉天。

translations.literal: Telegraph lines: east to Haishenwai, north to Qiqihar, southwest to Fengtian.
translations.idiomatic: Telegraph lines ran east to Haishenwai, north to Qiqihar, and southwest to Fengtian.

sentences.zh: 吉林府：繁，疲，難。

translations.literal: Jilin Prefecture: crowded, worn, difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Jilin Prefecture: crowded, worn, difficult.

sentences.zh: 總督駐奉天。

translations.literal: The governor-general was stationed at Fengtian.
translations.idiomatic: The governor-general was stationed at Fengtian.

sentences.zh: 巡撫兼副都統，民政、交涉、提學、提法、度支司，勸業道駐。

translations.literal: The governor also served as deputy commander; the civil affairs, foreign affairs, education, judicial, and finance bureaus, and the industry promotion circuit intendant, were all stationed there.
translations.idiomatic: The governor also served as deputy commander; the civil affairs, foreign affairs, education, judicial, and finance bureaus, along with the industry promotion circuit intendant, were all stationed there.

sentences.zh: 明，烏拉等衛。

translations.literal: Under the Ming, the Wula guard and others.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Ming dynasty, it was the Wula guard and related posts.

sentences.zh: 後屬扈倫族之烏拉部。

translations.literal: Later it belonged to the Wula tribe of the four Hulun tribes.
translations.idiomatic: Later it belonged to the Wula tribe of the four Hulun confederations.

sentences.zh: 本吉林烏拉，一曰烏拉雞林，又名船廠。

translations.literal: Originally Jilin Wula, also called Wula Jilin, also known as the Shipyard.
translations.idiomatic: Originally Jilin Wula, also called Wula Jilin and known as the Shipyard.

sentences.zh: 清初，隸寧古塔將軍。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Qing, it was under the General of Ningguta.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Qing it fell under the General of Ningguta.

sentences.zh: 康熙十五年徙駐。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Kangxi the garrison was transferred there.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year of the Kangxi reign the garrison was transferred there.

sentences.zh: 雍正五年置永吉州，隸奉天。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Yongzheng, Yongji Department was established, under Fengtian.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of the Yongzheng reign, Yongji Department was established under the jurisdiction of Fengtian.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十二年改吉林廳，仍隸將軍。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Qianlong it was changed to Jilin Subprefecture, still under the general.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of the Qianlong reign it was redesignated as Jilin Subprefecture, still under the general.

sentences.zh: 光緒八年升為吉林省治，領伊通、敦化，後削。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Guangxu it was promoted to the provincial seat of Jilin, administering Yitong and Dunhua — later reduced.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of the Guangxu reign it was promoted to the provincial seat of Jilin, administering Yitong and Dunhua — jurisdictions later reduced.

sentences.zh: 西南至京師二千三百里。

translations.literal: Southwest to the capital is two thousand three hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: It lay two thousand three hundred li southwest of the capital.

sentences.zh: 距盛京八百二十餘里。

translations.literal: It is over eight hundred twenty li from Shengjing.
translations.idiomatic: It stood over eight hundred twenty li from Shengjing.

sentences.zh: 隸西南路道。

translations.literal: It was under the Southwest Route circuit intendant.
translations.idiomatic: It fell under the Southwest Route circuit intendant.

sentences.zh: 廣四百九十里，袤五百餘里。

translations.literal: It measured four hundred ninety li in breadth and over five hundred li in length.
translations.idiomatic: It measured 490 li from east to west and over 500 li from north to south.

sentences.zh: 北極高四十五度四十九分。

translations.literal: Its latitude is forty-five degrees forty-nine minutes north.
translations.idiomatic: Its latitude is 45°49′ north.

sentences.zh: 京師偏東十度二十七分。

translations.literal: It lies ten degrees twenty-seven minutes east of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: It lies 10°27′ east of the capital.
